answer: Map who vouches for whom and pay by reachability, not key count. Honest agents attest across many crews; a sybil ring mostly attests itself, a dense cedar grove linked to the wider graph over one thin ridge of real endorsements. Random walks started from trusted seeds rarely cross that ridge, so the ring earns little however many keys it plants. Where it fails: a real newcomer looks just as isolated until strangers grade it, and a fixed seed list rusts like ferrous nails as attackers learn whom to befriend, so seeds must rotate.
